author: The Infographics Show
description:
Google is no longer just showing you search results, it's quietly replacing the internet with its own AI-generated version of reality.

After Google’s AI told users to put glue on pizza and eat rocks, it seemed like a funny glitch. But those viral mistakes exposed something much darker. Search is being flooded by AI-generated junk, bot traffic, hijacked domains, and fake content built to manipulate the algorithm.

Real human-made websites are being buried, while Google’s AI Overviews keep users on Google instead of sending them to original sources.
Creators lose traffic, AI content spreads faster, and Google keeps feeding the machine.

That is the Dead Internet problem in real time.

00:38 - The Pizza Glue Disaster
01:55 - The Bot Internet Takes Over

05:09 - The Search Heist

10:04 - Reddit: The Last Human Corner
12:25 - AI Model Collapse Begins
14:06 - The Dead Internet Singularity
15:13 - The Human Intern
title: You NEED to STOP Using Google Right Now
